summary: Dense right lower lobe consolidation seen on prior has largely cleared on current, with aerated lung now visible in that region.

findings.rationale: Prior shows a sharply marginated, homogeneous wedge-shaped right lower lobe opacity with air bronchograms extending to the hemidiaphragm; current right lower zone in the same anatomic region (matched by hilum and diaphragm) shows return of vascular lung markings and only mild residual haze, despite mild rotation/positioning differences.
